title: Dreaming for years about this mall
content: So my wife and I have both been dreaming about this mall for years. My most vivid memories involve 4 places. 1. A glass elevator in a waterfall type area, the waterfall drops into an indoor pool. Very bright lighting and at least 5+ stories high at this point. 2. A midway type area, with Disneyland style rides 3. The airport which has been described on here already from what I've seen. 4. A small shop filled with wool gnomes and gargoyles, there's an entrance on the outside of the mall. From that point all i can see is just towering concrete beyond imagination. The shop is very gloomy inside and packed tight. Barely room to walk, maybe 800 Sq ft in a rectangle shape. Anyone else encounter these areas?
